title: Dune Oasis 3D kit - Made with Astra, fine tuned with 6.2 Astra
author: Efficient_Ad8214
selftext:
Build your own: place palms, shrubs, grass, rocks. Save it.

Whats Inside

1. Drifting dust haze

2. Mirage system 

3. Cloud skies, several of them

4. Sun, moon, night mode, control the sun’s direction

5. A water system with 16 controls: colour, clarity, waves, capillaries, shimmer

6. Sand shaders with wind ripples and drift



Everything is WebGPU. Runs at 60 fps at native 4K on an M4 Pro.

Wishlist here [https://3ditions.drop3.app/notify/dune-oasis/](https://3ditions.drop3.app/notify/dune-oasis/)
